edges.subject: Grn-/- mice
edges.object: reduced a-wave amplitude of scotopic electroretinogram
edges.quote: The a-wave amplitude of scotopic electroretinogram and outer nuclear thickness were significantly reduced at 6 months of age in Grn-/- mice compared to wild-type (Grn+/+) mice.

edges.subject: Grn-/- mice
edges.quote: In Grn-/- mice, retinal microglial cells accumulated on the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) apical layer, and the number of infiltrated microglia and white fundus lesions between 2 and 6 months of age showed a close affinity.

edges.quote: Our data suggest that the subretinal translocation of microglia is a characteristic phenotype in the retina of mature PGRN knockout mice.
